content.comment_body: Hello, Is there a way to enable access to parameters (such as timers) exclusively in ADMIN mode, while preventing access in OP mode? If so, what steps are required to set this up? Thanks.

As far as I know, that's not possible. The protection feature in the block properties only prevents [product_name] from switching to parameterization mode in OP mode by ensuring it can't enter STOP. To restrict access, the only method I know is to set up a password-protected message and implement the password check yourself.

Thanks for the feedback. Maybe I was unclear earlier. I want to block access to the following menu in OP mode, and allow it in ADMIN mode: [DOWN]->[ESC]->[SETTINGS]->[PROGRAM]->[SET PARAMETER]. This menu is currently the only way users can change timer values, not through a message. I thought I managed to restrict this menu before. Hardware involved: [product_name] with [product_name] display.

Unfortunately, it's not possible to lock that menu. However, it's not necessary either. In the parameter menu, only blocks are shown if [product_name] is in STOP mode. Since in OP mode it can't be switched to STOP, users can't access them. Additional note: If a timer's value is viewable via a message screen, it can also be edited directly from the display.

That's odd—I recall being able to do this previously, possibly on an older firmware version. I've reached out to support and sent them relevant details and the program. If I receive a solution, I'll share it here. Thank you for your assistance.
It looks like the only viable solution is to fully protect all parameters and utilize ADMIN mode to stop the program and access settings. It’s not ideal, but it can work.

Hello, You can monitor parameter changes in parameter mode using the navigation (ESC, Down, Program, parameter). Each function block you wish to protect can be configured in its properties. However, switching between ADMIN and OPERATOR mode does not allow viewing parameters directly in parameter mode. Hope this clarifies things.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for ways to restrict timer parameter modifications to ADMIN mode on the [product_name] device with display, so OP mode cannot alter settings directly via the menu. There's confusion about what protections are available, possibly because of differing firmware versions, and opinions vary about feasibility. The only workaround mentioned is to protect all parameters and use admin privileges to stop the system before changing them, which is seen as less than ideal.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that access to parameter modifications (like timers) can be limited strictly to ADMIN mode, ensuring OP mode users cannot access or change these settings through the device interface.
